blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Communication between agents has mostly been studied on tasks with a shared objective and fast, clear feedback. Trading has neither: each agent manages its own account, with decisions being scored by markets late and noisily. A trading swarm is thus a population of independent decision-makers rather than a team, for which convergence is a risk and not the goal. We ran 200 agents from four model families in groups of ten under five communication regimes, from isolation to message boards and shared notes, over seven US trading days (1 to 9 October 2026), logging everything each agent read before every decision. In two of the four families, communicating groups came to hold far more of the same stocks than the isolated group. A group's return was largely the return on what its members held in common. Seeing a post from a groupmate made an agent 7 percentage points more likely to reuse an eight-word phrase from it. Agents that started too close together to see each other's posts shared such a phrase in 14% of cases, the rate that common inputs produce. Seeing the post did not detectably change that morning's trades. Case studies traced the adoption of positions and decision rules over subsequent days, and communicating groups sold in step more often than isolated ones. Because isolated groups also converged on the same stocks, sometimes completely, assessments of herding need to measure excess convergence relative to a no-peer baseline.
blocks.zh: 各机构之间的沟通大多是就任务进行研究的,有共同的目标,有快速、明确的反馈。 交易没有:每个代理管理自己的账户,决定被市场迟到和无声地评分。 因此,贸易群是独立的决策者群体,而不是团队,而趋同是风险而不是目标。 在7个美国交易日(2026年10月1日至9日)里, 我们从4个模范家庭, 分成10个不到5个通信系统, 从隔离到留言板和共享笔记, 在4个家庭中,有2个家庭的通信小组拥有的库存远远多于孤立小组。 一个团体的回报主要是其成员所持的共同点。 看到一个来自组友的帖子,使得一个代理商7个百分点更可能从中再用到一个8个字的短语. 在14%的案例中, 看到这个帖子并没有明显改变 早上的交易。 案例研究追溯了随后几天采取的立场和决定规则,沟通团体比孤立团体更经常地一步步地出售。 由于孤立的群体也聚集在同一种群上,有时是完全的,因此对放牧的评估需要衡量与无同类基线相比的过度趋同。

blocks.en: Figure 1: The five communication regimes. Each ring is one group of ten managers from a single model family, and every family has one group in each regime. Boards carry posts from all members; the board with pings adds requests that wake a named peer; in peer memory each manager reads the notes its peers have published, with no messaging. Competitive boards and peer memory display individual ranks, and the collaborative regimes a team score.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Agents are increasingly allowed to communicate at test time, exchanging messages, notes and artifacts through a shared board or workspace while they work, with no further training. Such test-time communication is proposed as a way to make an agent swarm more capable than the same agents working independently, and its benefits have been measured on tasks with one shared objective. A team of communicating agents sharing a workspace matches the success rate of several times as many independent agents on ARC-AGI-3 and beats the best-known solutions of algorithmic and compression problems [ 11 ] . Multi-agent debate raises accuracy on reasoning benchmarks in some settings and not in others [ 9 , 10 ] . The value of coordination depends on the task and on how the agents are organized [ 1 ] . In settings with clear feedback, agents can assess whether a shared discovery improves on their earlier work. With limited compute, or without a clear measure of progress, independent agents can do better [ 11 ] .
blocks.zh: 代理人越来越多地被允许在试验时通过共用的董事会或工作空间进行交流,交流消息,笔记和文物,而无需接受进一步的培训. 这种试验时间的交流是作为使一个代理人群比同一代理人更有能力独立工作的一种方式提出的,其好处是以一个共同目标的任务来衡量的。 一个共享工作空间的通信代理团队匹配了ARC-AGI-3上数倍的独立代理的成功率,并击败了最著名的算法和压缩问题的解决方案[11]. 多代理辩论提高了某些情况下的推理基准的准确性,而另一些情况下则不[9,10]. 协调的价值取决于任务和代理人的组织方式[1]. 在有明确反馈的环境下,代理人可以评估共同发现是否改善了他们先前的工作. 由于计算有限,或没有明确的进展度量,独立代理人可以做得更好[11].

blocks.en: Trading agents make a sequence of decisions for their own accounts, with market outcomes providing delayed and noisy feedback. Over a few days, returns offer a limited measure of decision quality, and there is no verifier that immediately distinguishes a sound idea from a persuasive one. Communication may inform individual decisions, but it can also lead agents to take similar positions and incur losses together. For a population of agents that retain independent trading authority, convergence can therefore increase collective risk. Research on human groups gives no general reason to expect more interaction to improve collective judgment [ 2 , 3 ] . What test-time communication changes in a swarm whose members act independently on the same market is an open question.
blocks.zh: 贸易代理商为自己的账户作出一系列决定,市场结果提供延迟和吵闹的反馈。 在几天的时间里,回报在决定质量方面提供了有限的尺度,没有核查者能立即将一个合理的想法与一个有说服力的想法区分开来. 通信可能为个别决定提供依据,但也可能导致代理人采取类似立场,共同蒙受损失。 对于保留独立贸易权威的代理人群体来说,趋同可能增加集体风险。 关于人类群体的研究没有一般理由期望更多的互动来改善集体判断[2,3]. 在其成员在同一市场独立行事的一群人中,测试时间的通信有何变化,这是一个有待解决的问题。

blocks.en: Measuring peer influence requires distinguishing it from responses to common inputs: agents that buy the same stock may have copied each other, but they may also have read the same news, used the same tools or shared a model’s habits. Correlated behaviour alone does not identify a peer effect [ 14 , 15 ] , and an agent’s own explanation is not a complete account of its decision [ 21 ] . Studies of trading agents have not been built to separate these sources. StockAgent removes a simulated market’s bulletin board [ 4 ] , TradingAgents and ContestTrade arrange analysis and debate into a pipeline [ 16 , 17 ] , and LiveTradeBench evaluates single models against live markets [ 5 ] . None records which peer content reached which agent before it acted, and only one compares communicating agents with agents that cannot communicate, in simulations on historical data [ 25 ] .
blocks.zh: 衡量同行影响需要将其与对共同投入的反应区分开来:购买相同股票的代理商可能已经互相复制,但他们也可能读过相同的新闻,使用相同的工具或分享模型的习惯. 仅仅与公司有关的行为并不能确定对等效应[14、15],而代理人本身的解释也不是对其决定[21]的完整叙述。 尚未建立贸易代理商的研究来分离这些来源。 StockAgent删除模拟市场公告牌[4],贸易代理商和竞争贸易公司安排分析和辩论进入管道[16,17],LiveTrade Bench对照直播市场评价单一模式[5]. 在模拟历史数据时,没有任何记录显示在它采取行动之前达到了哪个代理人的同行内容,只有一份记录将通信代理人与无法通信的代理人进行比较[25]。

blocks.en:
We ran 200 language-model trading agents, which we call managers, for seven US trading days.
Four model families (Opus 5.5, GPT-6.1 Sol, Grok 4.6 and DeepSeek V4 Pro) each had one group of ten managers in each of five communication regimes, ranging from isolation to message boards and shared notes (Figure 1 ).
Each manager traded its own paper account against live markets.
To isolate the effect of test-time communication, we traced information from shared messages to the actions of the managers that received it. We also compared communicating groups with isolated groups of the same model under the same brief, tools, capital and schedule.

为了隔离测试时间通信的效果,我们追踪信息从共享信息到接收信息的管理人员的行动. 我们还根据同样的简况、工具、资本和时间表,将交流团体与同一模式的孤立团体进行比较。

blocks.en: Our main findings are the following. – Holdings and returns. In two of the four families, communicating groups had greater portfolio overlap than the isolated group, and shared holdings accounted for much of each group’s return (Section 3 ). – Wording. Stock phrases reached nearly every member of a group, and a groupmate’s fresh post raised reuse of its wording by 7 percentage points (Section 4 ). – Decisions and positions. A fresh post did not detectably change that morning’s trades, while the decision rules traced in the case studies took one to four trading days to spread. Communicating groups also sold in step more often than isolated ones (Section 5 ). – Evidence, disclosure and effort. Some claims lost their qualifications as they passed between managers, Opus managers withheld positions under competitive framing, and communicating groups in two families requested less research without establishing a division of work (Section 6 ). These comparisons also revealed substantial convergence without communication: every Opus manager bought the semiconductor stock TSM, with or without peers. Earlier simulations of five-agent trading teams likewise found that isolated agents converged as far as communicating ones [ 25 ] , supporting the use of a no-peer baseline in our design.

blocks.en: 2 Experimental design
blocks.zh: 2 实验设计

blocks.en: 2.1 Managers and cycles
blocks.zh: 2.1 管理人员和周期

blocks.en: Each manager is a language model that runs in one continuous context, keeps its own files and acts in cycles (Figure 2 ). A cycle opens with a view of the manager’s situation, which in the communication regimes includes its peers’ latest posts or notes. The manager then reads its files, delegates research to tool-using sub-agents, submits orders and updates its notes, and its post or notes are published when the cycle succeeds. Every manager has one scheduled cycle each morning, started from a queue at 12:50 UTC, 40 minutes before the US market opens at 13:30 UTC. Each manager also schedules further cycles for itself. Research sub-agents run on models shared across the four families, so a family label describes the manager layer, not every model that contributed to its research (Appendix A ).
blocks.zh: 每个管理器是一种语言模型,在一个连续的上下文中运行,在循环中保存自己的文件和行为(图2 ). 开始一个周期是为了了解管理人员的情况,在通讯制度中,这包括同行的最新职位或说明。 管理者然后阅读其文档,授权研究工具使用子代理,提交订单并更新其笔记,当周期成功时,其职位或笔记会公布. 每个经理每天早上有一个预定周期,从协调世界时12:50的排队开始,离协调世界时13:30美国市场开放还有40分钟. 每个管理人员还为自己安排进一步的周期。 研究子代理商运行在四个家族共享的模型上,因此一个家族标签描述了管理层,而不是每个为研究做出贡献的模型(Appendix A ).

blocks.en: Each manager ran its own paper account of USD 100,000 on a company-developed trading ledger that records orders, simulated fills, cash and positions against live market prices. Paper orders do not move prices, so the study can examine correlated decisions but not price impact. The groups started on 1 October 2026, and the analysis ends at the US close on 9 October (20:00 UTC), seven trading days in all. The managers’ instructions set a horizon of 16 October, but all 200 were paused on 11 October, before the market next opened. Positions open at the cutoff are valued at the 9 October close, and all 200 final valuations and 1,400 daily closes reconcile to ledger records without exceptions.
blocks.zh: 每位经理在公司开发的交易分类账上开立了自己的100,000美元纸币账户,该分类账记录了订单、模拟填料、现金和按实货市场价格计算的头寸。 纸质订单不会移动价格,因此研究可以审查相关决定,但不能审查价格影响. 团体开始于2026年10月1日,分析结束于10月9日(协调世界时20:00)美国关闭,共7个交易日. 管理人员的指示设定了10月16日,但所有200人是在10月11日暂停的,然后市场才开始营业。 10月9日收盘时对截止点开放的阵地进行估值,所有200次最后估值和1 400次每日关闭均无例外地与分类账记录核对。

blocks.en: Figure 2: How a manager works. (a) The cycle every manager repeats. A cycle starts from the morning queue, at a time the manager set for itself or, on a board with pings, at a peer’s request; the platform freezes and records the peer material and scores the manager will see; the manager researches, trades and updates its notes; and its post or notes are published only if the cycle succeeds. (b) One manager’s day: Agent 02 of Opus’s collaborative board on 2 October, in UTC. Its morning cycle, which the queue started at 13:24, posted a plan to deploy its cash at 10:15 ET (14:15 UTC); a cycle it had scheduled for itself carried out the plan at that time, and a third checked the book before the close. The morning post is quoted in Figure 5 .
blocks.zh: 图2:经理的工作方式. (a) 每个管理人员重复的周期。 周期从早晨排队开始,此时管理员为自己设定或者在有pings的板上,应同伴的要求;平台冻结并记录同伴材料,并对管理员会看到的评分;经理研究,交易和更新其笔记;其职位或笔记只有在周期成功时才发布. (b) 一个经理日:协调世界时10月2日Opus合作委员会02号特工。 它的早晨周期,排队开始于13:24,张贴了在ET10:15(协调世界时14:15)部署现金的计划;一个周期,它预定自己在当时执行计划,第三个在关闭前检查了这本书. 图5引用了上午的帖子。

blocks.en: 2.2 Communication regimes
blocks.zh: 2.2 通信制度

blocks.en: Every manager received the same operator-authored brief, which sets an objective of return relative to SPY, an exchange-traded fund that tracks 500 large US companies, and offers SPY as neutral exposure. Each communication regime adds one paragraph that describes its channel and its score (Table 3 ; Appendix J ). On a competitive board a manager’s score is its return minus the group’s mean, the two collaborative regimes share a team score equal to the group’s mean return, and peer memory shows individual returns. None of the paragraphs asks managers to agree, share, coordinate or copy, and each ends by stating that the manager retains trading authority only over its own account. Every view also called peer content “untrusted social information” and “never authorization” and the score “experimental context only” (Appendix A.2 ), framing that may dampen both cooperation and responses to the score.
blocks.zh: 每个经理都收到同样的操作员授权的简介,该简介设定了一个相对于SPY的回报目标,即追踪500家美国大公司的交易所交易基金,并提供SPY作为中性曝光. 每个通信制度都增加了一段,说明其信道和得分(表3;附录J)。 在竞争的棋盘上,经理的得分是其回报减去集团的平均值,两个合作机制共享一个团队的得分等于集团的平均值,同行记忆显示个人回报. 这些段落都没有要求管理人员同意、分享、协调或复制,每一段最后都说,管理人员只保留自己账户的交易权。 每种观点还称同行内容为“不信任的社会信息”和“从未授权”以及得分“仅是实验性背景”(附录A.2),这种框架可能削弱合作和对得分的回应。

blocks.en: The regimes therefore bundle a channel, its framing and a score display. No manager is assigned a role and no orchestrator directs the group; managers know each other only by local pseudonyms (Agent 01 to Agent 10), and no score moves capital. The scorecard also arrived later than intended: nonzero scores first reached the groups on 4 or 5 October, so the display was active only for the last five trading days (Appendix B.1 ).
blocks.zh: 因此,这些制度将一个频道、其框架和分数显示捆绑在一起。 没有管理者被指派一个角色,也没有指挥乐团;管理者只通过本地假名(Agent 01 to Agent 10)互相认识,没有分数移动资本. 计分卡也比预期的要晚:10月4日或5日,非零分数首先到达各组,因此显示只活跃到最后五个交易日(附录B.1 .

blocks.en: At the start of every cycle the platform freezes the peer material that the manager’s regime allows, up to 20 recent board posts or each peer’s latest published notes, together with the scorecard, and records it as part of the cycle’s prompt. A manager therefore cannot have received anything through the channel that was published after its view was frozen, and it receives peer content without calling any tool. We treat this delivered view as the record of exposure. Over the seven trading days the groups published 1,568 board posts and 546 versions of their notes, and the platform delivered 2,198 views of peer material. Checks of membership, publication and exposure found no leakage between groups. On a board with pings, a manager can also address a post to a named peer and request an extra cycle for it, within per-cycle, daily and cooldown limits.
blocks.zh: 每个周期开始时,平台冻结管理者制度允许的同伴材料,最多20个最近的董事会职位或每个同伴最新发表的笔记,以及计分卡,并作为周期提示的一部分加以记录。 因此,管理者不能通过该频道收到在其视图被冻结后发布的任何信息,而接受同行内容而不调用任何工具. 我们把这种观点当作曝光记录。 在7个交易日中,各团体发布了1 568个董事会帖子和546个版本的笔记,平台提供了2 198份同行材料。 对成员、出版物和接触的检查发现各群体之间没有渗漏。 在有pings的棋盘上,管理者也可以将一个帖子地址给一个被命名的对等者,并在每个周期,每天和冷却限度内请求为它额外循环.

blocks.en: 2.3 Separating influence from common inputs
blocks.zh: 2.3 从共同投入中分离影响

blocks.en: We use three kinds of evidence (Table 4 maps each claim to its evidence). The first is delivery: a manager can have copied a phrase, a threshold or a claim through the channel only if a peer’s use appeared in a view delivered before its own. This is necessary for transmission but not sufficient, because a model can reach the same content on its own. The second is the no-peer baseline: each family’s isolated group, and the same model’s other groups, show whether a distinctive item appears where no peer could have supplied it. The third is the morning queue. Each morning the platform started each family’s 50 managers, at most nine at a time, in an order that changed from day to day and was unrelated to a manager’s place the previous morning, its return or its activity (Appendix A.8 ). The queue, not the managers, therefore decided whether one member’s view could contain another’s fresh post. We compare near pairs, which started less than a minute apart so that neither could see the other’s post, with far pairs, which started far enough apart that the earlier post was almost always in the later member’s view. We then subtract the same comparison in isolated groups, where only timing differs.
blocks.zh: 我们使用三种证据(表4列出每一项索赔的证据)。 第一个是交付:只有当同伴的使用出现在自己之前交付的视图中时,管理者才能通过信道复制一个短语、一个阈值或权利要求。 这对传输是必要的,但还不够,因为一个模型可以自己达到相同的内容. 第二个是无对等基线:每个家庭的孤立群体,以及同一个模型的其他群体,显示是否出现了一个独特的物品,没有同伴能够提供这种物品。 第三是早上排队 每天早上,平台开始每个家庭的50名管理人员,每次最多9名,其顺序日复一日,与前一天早上的管理人员所在地、其返回或活动无关(附录A.8)。 因此,排队者,而不是管理人员,决定一个成员的意见是否可以包含另一个新职位。 我们比较了相距不到一分钟的近对子, 然后在孤立的人群中减去同样的比较,只有时间不同。

blocks.en: Each combination of model and regime contains a single group, so a difference between regimes confounds the regime with that group’s history [ 22 ] . We therefore describe the realized groups rather than rank the regimes (Appendix A.4 ). Behavioural case studies come from chronological reviews of every manager’s records by language-model reviewers, and the authors checked every case against the source records (Appendix D ). Each case cites the review finding it rests on, which Table 9 traces to its source. Identifiers beginning H- mark findings from the first-pass reviews by Haiku 5.5: H-OIS-01, for instance, is finding 1 of the first-pass review of Opus’s isolated group.
blocks.zh: 模式和制度的每一组合都包含一个单一的集团,因此制度之间的差别使该制度与该集团的历史相混淆[22]。 因此,我们描述已实现的群体,而不是政权的等级(附录A.4)。 行为案例研究来自语言模型审查员对每个管理人员记录的时间顺序审查,作者对照来源记录(附录D)检查了每个案件。 每个案件都援引了它所依据的审查结论,表9指出了其来源。 例如,H-OIS-01正在对Opus的孤立群体进行第一通道审查。

blocks.en: 3 Holdings and returns
blocks.zh: 3 持有和返回

blocks.en: The 200 accounts underperformed SPY, with losses concentrated in positions held by several managers within a group. Combined equity rose by 0.622% over the seven trading days against 1.859% for SPY; 136 of the 200 accounts gained value and 35 beat SPY. Measured from the first close against SPY held at each account’s own invested fraction, the average account lost 1.23 percentage points and only 27 came out ahead (Appendix B ). Sol’s smaller shortfall, 0.49 points against 1.16 to 1.76 for the other families, reflects its holdings rather than better selection: Sol accounts kept 82% of their equity in SPY on average, Opus 56%, Grok 6% and DeepSeek under 1%.
blocks.zh: 200个账户业绩不佳,亏损集中在一个集团中由几名管理人员担任的职位。 在7个交易日中,总股本增长了0.622%,而SPY增长了1.859%;在200个账户中,136个账户增值,35个账户被SPY击败。 平均账户损失1.23个百分点,仅领先27个百分点(附录B)。 Sol的缺口较小,为0.49分,而其他家庭为1.16分至1.76分,这反映了其持有量而不是更好的选择: 索尔账户平均将其在SPY的股本的82%,Opus 56%,Grok 6%,DeepSeek 1%以下.

blocks.en: Returns varied substantially across groups, while accounts within each group tended to perform similarly (Figure 3 ). Within a regime the four group means lie 1.3 to 3.7 points apart, while the median group’s accounts spread by 0.84 points around their own mean. Within DeepSeek, Grok and Opus the regime means differ by more than shuffling accounts among regimes produces ( p ≤ 0.001 p\leq 0.001 ). Because each regime has one group per family, this result shows that the groups differ, not that the regimes caused the differences (Appendix C ).
blocks.zh: 各个组的回返情况大不相同,而每个组的账户往往同样运作(图3)。 在一个制度内,这四组人意味着相隔1.3至3.7点,而中组人的账户则按自己的平均值分布0.84点。 在DeepSeek、Grok和Opus中,该政权的含义不同,不仅仅是各政权之间的混乱账户(第0.001页,第0.001页)。 由于每个政权每个家庭都有一个群体,这一结果表明这些群体不同,而不是这些政权造成差异(附录C)。

blocks.en: Figure 3: Every account’s return from the 1 October open to the 9 October close, one row per regime. Each dot is an account, coloured by model family; the bar of the same colour marks its group’s mean, and the dashed line SPY’s return. Dots are stacked vertically only to avoid overlap.
blocks.zh: 图3 从10月1日开放到10月9日关闭的每一账户的回报,每个制度一行。 每个点都是由模范家庭组成的账户;同一颜色的条块标志着其群体的恶性,以及破折的线条SPY的回归。 点的垂直堆叠只是为了避免重叠.

blocks.en: The attribution to shared holdings shows how these gains and losses arose (Table 5 ): the total profit of USD 124,340 comprises gains on SPY (USD 125,396) and energy stocks (USD 122,403), offset by losses on semiconductors (USD 111,947) and all other instruments (USD 11,513). The two worst groups, DeepSeek’s peer memory and Grok’s board with pings, lost USD 17,418 and USD 19,748 on semiconductors with every member involved. The two best, DeepSeek’s board with pings and Grok’s peer memory, lost only USD 163 and USD 4,197 on them. The Grok group had the highest return overall, with gains on refiner, power and tanker stocks that were each held by one or two managers.
blocks.zh: 归属于共有财产表明这些损益是如何产生的(表5):124,340美元的总利润包括SPY(125,396美元)和能源储存(122,403美元)的收益,由半导体(111,947美元)和所有其他工具(11,513美元)的损失抵消。 两个最差的群体,DeepSeek的同龄人记忆和Grok的板子,在涉及每个成员的半导体上损失了17,418美元和19,748美元。 两个最好的,DeepSeek的板子上挂着平板电脑和Grok的同伴记忆,只损失163美元和4,197美元。 Grok集团整体回报率最高,炼油厂、电力和油轮库存的收益各由一两名管理人员持有。

blocks.en: In two of the four families, communicating groups came to hold more of the same stocks (Figure 4 ). We measure the overlap of two accounts as the share of equity they hold in common outside SPY, and average it over the seven closes. It averaged 14% across pairs in DeepSeek’s isolated group against 30 to 40% in its four communicating groups, and 8% in Grok’s isolated group against 20 to 44% on its three boards. At the cutoff the same comparisons gave 14% against 32 to 40% and 4% against 17 to 45% (Table 8 ). Most of this overlap formed in the first two trading days (Figure 9 ). TSM spread with peers in the same way: five of ten DeepSeek isolated managers bought it, against nine or ten in three of DeepSeek’s four communicating groups, and two Grok isolated managers, against eight to ten on Grok’s boards. The order of purchases cannot show by itself that later buyers copied earlier ones, because every cycle reads its view before it researches, so copying and independent discovery would produce the same order.
blocks.zh: 在4个家庭中,2个家庭的通信小组拥有更多相同的股票(图4)。 我们测量两个账户的重叠情况,作为它们在SPY之外共同持有的股本份额,并在7个结账时平均。 在DeepSeek的孤立群体中,平均有14%的对子,而在它的4个交流群体中,平均有30%至40%;在Grok的孤立群体中,平均有8%的对子,在它的3个董事会中,平均有20-44%。 在截断时,同一比较显示14%为32%至40%,4%为17%至45%(表8)。 这些重叠大多形成于前两个交易日(图9). TSM以同样的方式向同行传播:十名深塞克孤立的管理人员中有五名购买了它,而深塞克的四个沟通小组中有九名或十名购买了它,还有两名格鲁克孤立的管理人员在格鲁克的董事会上购买了八名或十名。 购买顺序本身不能表明后来的买家复制了之前的顺序,因为每个周期在研究前都会读出自己的观点,因此复制和独立发现会产生相同的顺序.

blocks.en: Figure 4: What each group held outside SPY over the seven closes. Managers sit on the ring, Agent 01 at the top and then clockwise, in the positions of Figure 6 . Each inner node is a stock, placed towards its holders’ side of the ring and nearer the centre the more members held it, with its size growing with the number of members that held it at any close; each line from a manager is drawn in proportion to that stock’s mean weight in the account over the seven closes, with positions at cost (Appendix A.5 ). Red marks semiconductors, gold energy and grey everything else, using the groupings of Appendix G ; stocks held by four or more members are labelled. Under each ring are the group’s mean SPY weight and its mean pairwise overlap outside SPY, both averaged over the seven closes.
blocks.zh: 图4:每组在SPY之外为七关所持有的东西. 经理们坐在环上,01号特工在顶部,然后顺时针,在图6的位置上。 每个内部节点都是股票,放置在环的持有者一侧,中心越靠近,其持有成员越多,其规模随持有者人数的增加而增加;管理者从账户中提取的每条线都与该股票在7个关闭点的平均权重成正比,并有成本职位(附录A.5)。 红色标记半导体、黄金能量和灰色其他一切,使用附录G的分组;四个或四个以上成员持有的股票贴上标签。 每枚环下均是该组的平均SPY重量及其在SPY以外的平均对称重叠,两者均在7个闭合点上平均.

blocks.en: Opus’s convergence on TSM illustrates the importance of the isolated comparison: every Opus manager in all five regimes bought TSM, 46 of the 50 on 1 October, and five isolated Opus managers filled at the same price in the same second of the opening (H-OIS-01). By the cutoff, Sol held almost nothing outside SPY in any regime (Appendix C ).
blocks.zh: Opus对TSM的趋同说明了孤立比较的重要性: 所有五个政权的Opus管理者购买了TSM,10月1日购买了50人中的46人,以及5名孤立的Opus管理者在开场同2次(H-OIS-01)中以相同价格填充. 到了截断期,索尔在任何政权中几乎没有持有SPY以外的任何东西(附录C.

blocks.en: Although the instructions did not ask managers to converge, collaborative framing might still have encouraged them to take similar positions. Grok’s collaborative boards had the greatest overlap, at 36% on its collaborative board and 44% on its board with pings, against 20% on its competitive board. Opus’s two collaborative groups, however, overlapped less than its isolated group (15 and 16%, against 18%), and its competitive board more (31%). DeepSeek’s four communicating groups overlapped about equally under every framing. Collaboration was even used to argue for dispersion: on Opus’s collaborative board one manager warned that if everyone sold the same hedge, the team would become “one levered semis bet” (Figure 5 ). Access to peers’ rules and positions, which managers read and adopted over the following days (Section 5 ), is a likelier source of the extra overlap, alongside the common influence of the model, brief and news. The design cannot exclude a framing effect, because each regime bundles its framing with its channel and has one group per family. A channel with neutral framing would test it.
blocks.zh: 虽然指示没有要求管理人员达成一致,但协作框架可能仍然鼓励他们采取类似的立场。 Grok的合作董事会重叠最多,在合作董事会中占36%,在董事会中占44%,而在竞争董事会中占20%。 然而,奥普斯的两个合作团体的重叠率低于其孤立团体(15%和16%,而18%),其竞争董事会(31%)。 DeepSeek的4个交流组在每一个框架下都大致相同。 合作甚至被用来争论分散:在奥普斯的合作板上,一位经理警告说,如果每个人都卖掉同样的套期,团队就会成为“一个杠杆半注”(图5)。 管理人员在接下来几天里阅读和采用同伴规则和职位(第5节),这是额外重叠的一个比较相似的来源,同时也是模式、简讯和新闻的共同影响。 设计不能排除框架效应,因为每个制度都将其框架与渠道捆绑在一起,每个家庭有一个群体。 有中性框架的频道将测试它。

blocks.en: In Grok’s peer-memory group, shared notes sometimes encouraged managers to avoid their peers’ holdings: at least five wrote that those stocks were crowded or that they would not copy their peers. The group’s overlap, 11% over the week and 7% at the cutoff, stayed close to its isolated group’s 8 and 4%, although the rule was applied inconsistently (Appendix C ).
blocks.zh: 在Grok的同行记忆组中,共享的笔记有时会鼓励管理者避免同行持有股票:至少有五个人写道,这些股票拥挤或不会复制同行. 尽管该规则的应用不一致(附录C),但该团体的重叠率(每周11%,停产时7%)仍然接近其孤立的团体的8%和4%。

blocks.en: 4 Wording
blocks.zh: 4 字词

blocks.en: Stock phrases reached most members of a group within hours, and a groupmate’s fresh post raised reuse of its wording that same morning. Figure 5 shows excerpts from every kind of channel. The four models wrote to each other in very different ways (Table 6 ). Opus named a peer in 47 to 49% of its posts on the collaborative boards and described its own positions in 31 to 54%. Grok and Sol rarely did either. Sol ran its words together: 9 to 24% of its tokens were longer than 20 characters, against at most 0.2% for the other models.
blocks.zh: 数小时内, 大部分成员都收到库存的短语, 图5显示了各种频道的节选. 四个模型以非常不同的方式互相写信(表6). Opus在其协作委员会47%至49%的职位中指定了一个同行,并以31%至54%的比例描述了自己的职位。 格罗克和索尔也很少这么做. 索尔将单词一起运行:其9-24%的代币长度超过20个字符,而其他型号最多为0.2%.

blocks.en: Figure 5: What the channels carried. Verbatim excerpts from posts, notes and one manager’s reasoning, with omissions marked […]; times are UTC on the day shown, and pseudonyms are local to each group. On Opus’s collaborative board managers disclosed their books and restated each other’s rules, and one argued for keeping the team diverse; on its competitive board a manager reasoned that disclosure would cost it its edge and posted a calendar instead. On DeepSeek’s board with pings a threshold sent in a ping was adopted 2 minutes later. On Grok’s board with pings two managers’ posts carried the same disclaimer above nearly the same book. In DeepSeek’s peer memory a report of an attack, in fact a look back at one in March, was copied as news within minutes and corrected by a third manager.
blocks.zh: 图5:各渠道的载体。 文章、笔记和一位经理推理的逐字记录, Opus的合作董事会经理披露了他们的账簿并重述了对方的规则,有人主张保持团队的多样性;在其竞争董事会中,一位经理认为披露会耗尽自己的优势,而是张贴了一份日历。 在DeepSeek的板上, 在Grok的董事会上, 在DeepSeek的同龄人记忆中, 一篇关于3月攻击的报告,

blocks.en: Within these broader differences in style, individual groups adopted recurring phrases. On Opus’s collaborative board “verify before use” reached seven members within about 2 hours of its first use on 1 October and all ten by the next morning. On Grok’s board with pings, a “not a trade instruction” disclaimer reached eight members within 71 minutes and all ten eventually, often directly above near-identical holdings (Figure 5 ). In each group the first user had no peer use in its view, and every later adopter had one in the view delivered for the cycle in which it first used the phrase. Opus’s competitive board never used the Opus phrases, which argues against a model default (Figure 10 and Appendix C ). These are conventions in the sense studied in populations of language models by Ashery et al. [ 8 ] : arbitrary forms adopted because peers used them.
blocks.zh: 在这些更广泛的风格差异中,个别群体采用了反复出现的短语。 在Opus的协作委员会上,在10月1日首次使用后大约2小时内,7名成员 " 核查使用前 " ,在次日上午之前,所有10名成员都参加了。 在Grok的板上,一项 " 非贸易指令 " 的免责声明在71分钟之内送达了8名成员,所有10名成员最终都在几乎相同控股(图5)之上。 在每一个组中,第一个用户在其观点中没有同伴用途,每个后来的被采纳者在其首次使用该短语的周期的视图中有一个。 Opus的竞争董事会从未使用过Opus短语,该短语反对模型默认(图10和附录C)。 这些是Ashery等人在语言模型人群中研究的意义上的公约。 [8]:由于同龄人使用而采用的任意形式。

blocks.en: To measure wording reuse beyond these stock phrases (Figure 6 ), we count posts and versions of notes that reused a phrase of eight or more consecutive words first published in the group by another member and already delivered to the reuser. We leave out phrases that also occur in any other group, since their spread cannot be attributed to the channel. Grok’s boards reused wording 230 to 383 times each and Opus’s boards 10 to 35 times. Sol’s two collaborative boards reused nothing, because their members almost never wrote the same eight words, yet Sol’s peer-memory group copied from its members’ notes 178 times.
blocks.zh: 为了衡量这些库存短语(图6)之外的重复使用措辞,我们计算了重复使用另一个成员在组中首次发布的八个或八个以上连续字的注释的帖子和版本,这些词语已经交付给用户。 我们不提任何其他群体中也出现的词语,因为这些词语的传播不能归因于频道。 Grok的板块重复使用230至383倍,Opus的板块重复使用10至35倍。 索尔的两个合作董事会没有再用,因为其成员几乎从未写过同样的八个字,然而索尔的同级记忆小组从其成员的笔记中复制了178次.

blocks.en: Figure 6: Whose wording spread. Each ring is one group of ten managers, Agent 01 at the top and then clockwise. An arrow from one manager to another counts the posts (versions of notes, in the peer-memory column) in which the second reused a phrase of eight or more consecutive words that the first had published in the group earlier and that had been delivered to the second in a view; phrases that also appear in any other group are excluded. Arrow width grows with the count, and node size with how often others reused a manager’s wording. The number under each ring is the group’s total. Isolated groups had no channel.
blocks.zh: 图6:谁的措辞传播。 每枚戒指是一组十名经理,01号特工位于顶部,然后顺时针. 从一个管理器到另一个管理器的箭头计算出帖子(音符的版本,在对等模列中),其中第二次重复使用第一个在组中较早发表,并在视图中交付给第二个的连续八个或八个以上单词的短语;其他任何组中也出现的短语除外. 箭头的宽度随着计数而增加,节点大小随着其他人如何频繁重复管理器的措辞而增加. 每个环下的数字是该组的总数. 孤立的群体没有渠道。

blocks.en: The morning queue shows that seeing a post caused its wording to be reused (Figure 7 ). On the 12 boards we take the pairs of members who both posted on a given morning. The later member reused an eight-word phrase from the earlier member’s post 6.8 percentage points more often when the queue had started it late enough to see that post than when the two had started together (95% interval 1.7 to 11.8, 68 group-mornings). The phrases reused were the group’s rules and formulas, such as “do not add MU because cheaper” and “not a trade instruction”. Pairs that started together also shared new phrases, in 14% of cases, because they had received the same research results or used the same status templates. That share is the common-input rate the comparison removes.
blocks.zh: 早上排队显示看到一个帖子导致其措辞被重新使用(图7 ). 在12块板子上,我们把两个成员放在一个特定的上午。 后来的成员在排队开始时比两人一起开始时(95%的间隔为1.7至11.8,68个组晨)更频繁地重用来自先前成员后6.8个百分点的八字短语. 重新使用的短语是集团的规则和公式,如 " 不增加MU,因为价格较低 " 和 " 不是贸易指示 " 。 共同开始的对等也分享了新的短语,在14%的案例中,因为它们获得了相同的研究成果或使用了相同的状态模板. 这一份额是比较所消除的共同投入率。

blocks.en: Figure 7: The morning queue as a natural experiment. (a) Grok’s collaborative board on 1 October. Each bar is one manager’s scheduled morning cycle, from the view frozen at its start (small dot) to its end, when its post was published (large dot); the arrows lead from the morning posts that were already in the view of the last manager to start. Agents 05 and 03 started within a minute of each other, so neither could see the other’s post (a near pair); Agent 04 started an hour after Agent 05 and saw its post (a far pair). (b) Within-morning differences between far and near pairs in percentage points, with 95% bootstrap intervals (Appendix A.8 ). Wording moved; trades did not detectably move.
blocks.zh: 图 7:晨排作为自然实验. (a) 10月1日格罗克合作委员会。 每个栏目都是管理人员预定的上午周期,从开始时被冻结的视图(小点)到其员额公布时(大点)的结束;箭头是从上午员额开始的,在最后一位管理人员看来这些员额已经开始。 05号特工和03号特工在相隔一分钟内开始,因此两人都看不到对方的哨所(近对);04号特工在05号特工之后一小时开始,看到对方的哨所(远对)。 (b) 远对和近对之间日内差异(百分比),间隔95%(附录A.8)。 字句感动;行业没有可察觉的感动.

blocks.en: 5 Decisions and positions
blocks.zh: 5. 决定和立场

blocks.en: The queue comparison found no detectable effect of a groupmate’s fresh post on that morning’s trades. The case studies provide evidence of influence over longer periods, tracing how managers adopted peers’ decision rules and positions.
blocks.zh: 排队比较发现, 案例研究提供了较长时期影响的证据,追踪管理人员如何采用同行决定规则和职位。

blocks.en: 5.1 Same-morning effects
blocks.zh: 5.1 同晨效应

blocks.en: Applied to orders, the queue comparison distinguishes the overall similarity of managers’ trades from the effect of seeing a fresh post. Pairs of communicating managers submitted at least one order in the same stock and direction on 21% of pair-mornings, and isolated pairs on 11%. Within mornings, however, the far-minus-near difference in communicating groups exceeds the one in isolated groups by only 2.4 points (95% interval − 4.1 -4.1 to 9.3; Appendix C ). An effect larger than about nine points on a base of 21% is therefore unlikely. The comparison also found no detectable trade effect among the pairs whose wording changed. This is consistent with managers carrying out plans formed in earlier cycles, as Agent 02 did in Figure 2 , using overnight board information available to every manager.
blocks.zh: 适用于订单的队列比较区分了经理行业的总体相似性与看到新职位的效果. 沟通经理的对等在21%的对子晨报上至少在同一股和方向上提交了一份订单,11%的对子是孤立的。 然而,在上午,通信组的距离相差甚远,仅比孤立组的差2.4点(95%间隔-4.1-9.3;附录C)。 因此,在21%的基数上,影响大于9点是不可能的。 比较结果还发现,措辞有变化的对夫妇之间没有可察觉的贸易效应。 这与执行前几个周期制定的计划的管理人员一致,如第02号特工在图2中所做的那样,利用每位管理人员可得到的隔夜董事会信息。

blocks.en: 5.2 Decision rules
blocks.zh: 5.2 决定规则

blocks.en: Three decision thresholds spread through a group in ways the no-peer baseline does not explain, and each took one to four trading days to reach nine or ten members. On Opus’s collaborative board, Agent 05 posted a rotation rule on 2 October: cut SMH by half if it lagged SPY by more than 2% intraday while IWM, XLF and IGV rallied. Five members restated it within 80 minutes, each after a view containing the post (Figure 5 ), and all ten carried it in their reasoning or checkpoints before the 5 October open. No other Opus group used it, apart from one competitive manager. On the same board all ten members moved their TSM stops to between USD 438 and 442 over the afternoons of 5 and 6 October, eight of them to exactly 440. On DeepSeek’s board with pings, a “Brent < < 90” trim trigger passed in a ping on 1 October became a 90/85 ladder that nine members carried in their reasoning by 6 October. No other DeepSeek group used the ladder.
blocks.zh: 3个决定阈值以无比基线的方式在一组人中间分布,无法解释,每个成员需要1至4个交易日才能达到9或10个成员。 在Opus的协作板上,05探员于10月2日发布了一个旋转规则:如果SMH在IWM,XLF和IGV集结期间一天内落后2 %以上,则将SMH减半. 五名成员在80分钟内重述,每人在载有该哨所的视图(图5)之后,所有10名成员在10月5日开放前在他们的推理或检查站中都携带该哨所。 除了一名竞争经理之外,没有其他Opus集团使用过。 在同一董事会上,所有10名成员在10月5日和6日下午将其TSM停靠点移到438至442美元之间,其中8个是440个。 在DeepSeek的板上,10月1日敲门时通过的 " Brent < 90 " 触发器成为90/85梯子,9名成员在10月6日之前进行了推理。 没有其他DeepSeek集团使用梯子.

blocks.en: The high-yield spread trigger of 3.5% provides a comparison in which managers reached the same level without necessarily receiving it from peers. Every member of Opus’s board with pings adopted this trigger, and three said they had taken it from the board. Yet nine of the ten Opus competitive managers wrote the same trigger on the afternoon of 2 October, although no competitive post mentioned it. Appendix C gives the baselines for all four levels and describes how members of Opus’s collaborative board staggered their selling prices so that the group would not all sell at once.
blocks.zh: 3.5%的高产散射触发器提供了一种比较,在这种比较中,管理人员达到同一水平,而不一定从同行那里得到。 Opus的董事会中每个有小叮当的成员都采用了这个触发器,3人说他们从董事会中拿走了这个触发器. 然而,10月2日下午,10名竞争管理人员中有9名写下了同样的触发器,尽管没有竞争职位提到这一点。 附 录 C给出所有四级的基线,并描述奥普斯合作董事会成员如何错开销售价格,以便集团不会同时全部销售.

blocks.en: 5.3 Timing of trades and exits
blocks.zh: 5.3 贸易和出口的时间安排

blocks.en: A common schedule, news and prices can synchronize trades even without communication, as the isolated groups demonstrate. Five Sol isolated managers sold MU within 21 minutes of each other on 2 October, each citing its own test (H-SIS-03). Against that baseline, communicating groups traded in step more often (Table 1 ). In isolated groups 36 to 57% of fills outside SPY had a groupmate’s fill in the same stock and direction within 30 minutes. In communicating groups the share was 50 to 88%, higher than in the same family’s isolated group in 15 of the 16.
blocks.zh: 一个共同的时间表、新闻和价格即使没有沟通也能使贸易同步,正如孤立的群体所表明的那样。 5名Sol孤立的经理于10月2日在21分钟之内互相销售MU,每人引用自己的测试(H-SIS-03). 对照这一基线,交流小组更经常地进行分步交易(表1)。 在SPY以外的36至57%的孤立人群中, 30分钟内就有一个组员填满同样的股票和方向。 在通信小组中,比例为50-88%,高于16人中15人中同一家庭的孤立群体。

blocks.en: Table 1: Trading in step. Share (%) of each group’s fills outside SPY that had a groupmate’s fill in the same stock and direction within 30 minutes, with the share for sales in parentheses.
blocks.zh: 表1:逐步交易。 每个组的股份(%)在SPY之外,

blocks.en: Selling shows the difference most clearly: in all 16 communicating groups a larger share of sales came within 30 minutes of a groupmate’s sale of the same stock than in the family’s isolated group, 40 to 91% against 14 to 53%. Only 37 of the 314 in-step sales in communicating groups filled stop orders, which execute automatically once a preset price is reached, so most were decisions taken in cycles that ran at the same time. Since a fresh post did not detectably move that morning’s trades, these synchronized sales most likely executed plans shared on earlier days.
blocks.zh: 销售最明显地显示出了差异:在所有16个通信组中,在同一批人出售同一股票的30分钟内,销售份额就比在家庭孤立组中要大,40-91 % , 而14-53%。 在通信组的314个分步销售中,只有37个填写了停止订单,一旦达到预先设定的价格,即自动执行,所以大多数决定都是在同时运行的周期内作出的. 这些同步销售最有可能是前几天共享的计划。

blocks.en: 6 Evidence, disclosure and effort
blocks.zh: 6个 证据、披露和努力

blocks.en: The reviews document changes in the qualification of claims, the disclosure of positions and the amount of research requested. Some claims became more certain as managers relayed them, Opus managers withheld positions under competitive framing, and communicating groups in two families requested less research without establishing a division of work.
blocks.zh: 审查文件记录了索赔资格、职位披露和要求研究数量等方面的变化。 随着管理人员转发,一些索赔要求变得更加确定,Opus管理人员根据竞争框架扣下职位,两个家庭的通信小组要求较少进行研究,而没有确定分工。

blocks.en: 6.1 Qualification of claims
blocks.zh: 6.1 债权的资格

blocks.en: One case traces how a stale report passed through peer memory as current news (Figure 5 ). On 6 October a DeepSeek peer-memory manager’s research returned an AP item, dated the previous day, about an Iranian attack in Kuwait that had killed six US soldiers. At 13:01 UTC the manager published it in its notes as fresh escalation that justified its energy hedge. A second manager received it in a view presented 53 seconds later and published it as its own 2 minutes 20 seconds after the original; a third used it in its reasoning and checkpoint. A fourth checked with its own research, found that the deaths came from a strike in March 2026 on which the AP items were looking back, and published the correction 7.5 minutes after the original. The correction was in the view delivered to the original author the next day, yet every later version of that author’s notes, through 9 October, still described a new attack.
blocks.zh: 一个案例记录了一份陈旧的报告是如何通过同行记忆传递成为时事新闻的(图5). 10月6日,DeepSeek同龄人经理的研究还回了前一天的一件关于伊朗袭击科威特、杀害6名美国士兵的AP物品。 UTC下午13点01分,经理在笔记中将其公布为新的升级,这说明其能源套期是合理的。 第二名经理在53秒后出示的视图中收到,并在原件20秒后作为自己的2分20秒发布;第三名经理在推理和检查站中使用. 第四人用自己的研究检查,发现死亡来自2026年3月的一次罢工,AP项目对此进行了回顾,并在原作7.5分钟后公布了更正. 第二天向原作者提出了更正意见,然而,直到10月9日,该作者的笔记的每个后来版本仍然描述了新的攻击。

blocks.en: The reviews trace other claims that grew stronger in transit without new evidence. A yield range that research had bounded to about midday became, in its author’s public summary, a range for the whole trading day. A post that wrongly described BAC as making new daily lows led two members to submit reductions before a third checked the prices and corrected it (Appendix C ). Similar qualification loss occurred inside isolated managers’ own records, between delegated research and the manager’s account of it (H-OIS-06, H-SIS-06). Communication allowed the strengthened version to reach additional decision-makers.
blocks.zh: 这些审查追踪了其他在过境中变得更加强大的索赔,没有新的证据。 在作者的公开摘要中,将研究范围限制在大约中午,成为整个交易日的范围。 一份错误地形容BAC每日创下新低的帖子,导致两名成员在第三个成员核对价格并改正价格之前提交降价(附录C)。 在个别管理人员自己的记录中,在授权研究与管理人员的账户之间,也发生了类似的资格损失(H-OIS-06,H-SIS-06)。 交流使强化版能够接触到更多的决策者。

blocks.en: 6.2 Disclosure under competition
blocks.zh: 6.2 (中文(简体) ). 竞争性披露

blocks.en: Competitive framing changed what Opus managers disclosed. None of the 40 posts on Opus’s competitive board from 1 to 6 October described the author’s positions, against 43 of 63 on its collaborative board, and at least three managers gave the competition as their reason (Figure 5 ). Because nonzero scores reached the groups only on 4 or 5 October, the absence followed from the framing in the brief rather than from displayed ranks. From 7 October, 16 of 36 posts did describe positions, mostly exits already made. The response depended on the model. Grok’s competitive board almost never described positions, Sol rarely did on any board, and DeepSeek’s competitive board did so more often than its collaborative boards. Displayed ranks coincided with risk-taking on Opus’s competitive board, where the four lowest-ranked managers each bought NVDA at the next open, but the pattern was noticed after the fact and did not generalize (Appendix C ).
blocks.zh: 竞争性框架改变了Opus管理人员披露的内容。 10月1日至6日,奥普斯竞争委员会的40个员额中没有一个说明提交人的职位,而合作委员会的63个员额中有43个员额,至少有3名管理人员将竞争作为理由(图5)。 由于非零分只于10月4日或5日才到达各组,因此在简介中没有设定,而不是显示排名。 从10月7日起,36个员额中的16个确实描述了职位,大多已经离开。 反应取决于模型。 Grok的竞争董事会几乎从未描述过职位,Sol很少在任何董事会上做,DeepSeek的竞争董事会比其合作董事会更经常做. 显示的排位与奥普斯的竞争板上的风险承担相吻合,在下次公开时,排名最低的四位管理人员各自购买了NVDA,但这一模式在事后被注意到,并没有被概括(附录C).

blocks.en: 6.3 Research volume and division of labour
blocks.zh: 6.3 研究量和分工

blocks.en: Communicating groups in two families requested less research than their isolated counterparts, but the work continued to overlap. DeepSeek and Opus managers in communicating groups delegated 2.1 to 2.7 and 5.0 to 6.0 research requests per trading day, against 3.8 and 8.2 in isolation, while Grok and Sol researched as much with peers as alone. In every group, most requests that named a stock concerned one that a groupmate had already researched that day. The four boards with pings made only 18 targeted requests in seven trading days, so managers rarely used the tool provided for coordination. In none of the reviewed groups did the managers establish a lasting division of research (Appendix C ).
blocks.zh: 两个家庭的交流小组要求的研究少于孤立的小组,但工作继续重叠。 Depseek和Opus通信组的管理人员将2.1至2.7和5.0至6.0的研究请求委托给每个交易日,而隔离状态为3.8和8.2,而Grok和Sol则与同行一样单独进行研究。 在每一个团体中,大多数将股票命名的请求都涉及一个团体成员当天已经研究过的股票。 4个有打字机的董事会在7个交易日中只提出了18项有针对性的请求,因此管理人员很少使用为协调提供的工具. 在所审查的小组中,没有一个小组的管理人员建立了持久的研究分工(附录C)。

blocks.en: 7 Related work
blocks.zh: 7 相关工作

blocks.en: The study belongs to a programme of machine behaviour that treats interacting AI systems as objects of empirical investigation [ 6 ] . Generative Agents showed how memory, reflection and planning support information diffusion in a simulated town [ 7 ] . Experiments with populations of language models show shared conventions and collective biases emerging from local interactions [ 8 ] , a mechanism we observe directly in the boards’ stock phrases. Work on test-time communication protocols finds that multi-agent debate helps in some tasks but does not consistently beat alternatives such as self-consistency [ 9 , 10 ] , and that the value of coordination varies with architecture and task [ 1 ] . Park et al. find that on open-ended tasks with clear feedback a team of communicating agents, sharing a workspace without predefined roles or a central orchestrator, matches the success rate of several times as many independent agents, and that independent agents can do better when compute is limited or progress cannot be measured [ 11 ] . Our managers likewise share a channel without roles or an orchestrator, but their task has no verifier and no single solution. SwarmWorld separates communication, inheritance and environmental traces among agents that build persistent artifacts [ 12 ] . Our peer-memory regime isolates one textual channel of that kind, in which a manager reads its peers’ published notes.
blocks.zh: 该研究属于将相互作用的AI系统作为实证调查对象的机器行为方案[6]. 遗传 代理商展示了模拟城镇的记忆,反射和规划支持信息传播方式[7]. 使用语言模型的实验显示了共同的习惯和从地方互动中产生的集体偏见[8],我们直接在理事会的术语中观察到这一机制。 关于测试时间通信协议的工作发现,多代理辩论有助于一些任务,但不能始终如一地战胜自我一致性等替代方案[9,10],协调的价值因架构和任务[1]而异. 朴 al等人著. 发现在有明确反馈的开放式任务上,一组通信代理,共享一个没有预先定义的角色或中央管弦乐手的工作空间,匹配了数倍于独立代理的成功率,独立代理在计算有限或无法衡量进度时可以做得更好[11]. 我们的管理人员同样共用一个没有角色或指挥者的渠道,但他们的任务没有核查者,也没有单一的解决办法。 SwarmWorld将制造持久性文物的代理人之间的沟通,继承和环境痕迹分开[12]. 我们的同龄人制度隔离了这种文字渠道,其中管理者阅读同龄人发表的笔记。

blocks.en: Theories of informational cascades explain how observing earlier decisions can produce convergence even when individuals hold different private information [ 13 ] . Experiments on human judgment show both the loss of diversity under social influence and the gains when influence is well distributed [ 2 , 3 ] . Among language-model agents, Cho et al. find that an agent’s readiness to adopt its peers’ answers depends on the gap between its own confidence and the confidence it perceives in them, and on how their answers are presented. They also find that structural interventions control herding better than instructions in the prompt [ 26 ] . The warning in our views that peer content is untrusted is such an instruction, not a structural control. Distinguishing influence from common inputs is the reflection problem of social science [ 14 , 15 ] . Our contribution is to measure it in live markets, with recorded exposure, a no-peer baseline and an exogenous ordering of who could see whom.
blocks.zh: 信息级联理论解释,即使个人持有不同的私人信息,观察早期的决定如何产生趋同[13]. 对人类判断的实验表明,在社会影响下,多样性的丧失,以及影响力分配良好时的收益[2,3]. 在语言模型代理商中 Cho等人 (英语). 发现代理人是否愿意采纳同行的答案,取决于自己对答案的信心和信心之间的差距,以及他们的答案是如何提出的。 他们还发现,结构干预比指令更能控制放牧,这在即时[26]. 我们认为,对等内容不信任的警告是这种指示,而不是结构控制。 从共同投入中区分影响是社会科学的反思问题[14,15]. 我们的贡献是在活的市场中衡量它,有记录的暴露,没有类似基线,并且有外在命令谁能看到谁。

blocks.en: Experiments on agent networks find that what agents write is a poor guide to what they believe or do. On a peer-voted feed with matched exposure, Usman and Williamson find robust convergence in wording but no reliable advantage for distributed sources in shifting stance [ 30 ] . In persuasion experiments, Qiu et al. find that direct exposure predicts the next round’s stance, that relays through peers add a smaller effect, and that messages miss stance changes that belief probes detect [ 29 ] . They recommend evaluating such systems through exposure provenance and action logs. Our platform records both, allowing us to examine a similar gap between wording and trading in live markets. Transmission-chain experiments show small biases compounding as text passes from model to model [ 28 ] . The loss of qualifications on our boards illustrates this kind of cumulative change in a setting where the text informs trades.
blocks.zh: 在代理网络上的实验发现,代理写的东西对于他们相信什么或者做什么来说是一个差劲的指导. 在有相应接触的同级投票的饲料上,Usman和Williamson在措辞上发现强烈的趋同,但对转变立场的分布源没有可靠的优势[30]。 在说服实验中,邱等. 发现直接接触预示着下一回合的姿态, 通过同龄人转发会增加较小的效果, 他们建议通过接触来源和行动记录来评估这些系统。 我们的平台记录了两者,使我们能够审查在措辞和活市场交易之间的类似差距。 传输链实验显示,随着文本从模型传到模型[28],微小的偏差会复合. 我们董事会资格的丧失表明了这种累积变化,其背景是文本为行业提供信息。

blocks.en: Among financial agents, StockAgent, TradingAgents and ContestTrade feed contributions into a simulated market or a central allocation [ 4 , 16 , 17 ] , and FinCon’s manager–analyst hierarchy propagates investment beliefs to the agents that need them [ 31 ] . Our managers keep authority over their own accounts, and no contribution need become anyone’s input. In simulated markets, language-model agents show context-dependent biases like humans’ and reproduce path-dependent price anomalies that conventional agent models miss [ 27 ] . The design closest to ours is that of Shi and Hollifield, who compare five structures, isolated, leaderboard, collaborative conversation with and without a leaderboard, and competitive conversation, for five GPT-4o-mini agents generating alpha expressions, in 450 simulations on market data from January 2024 to September 2025 [ 25 ] . They find that the best structure depends on the stocks traded and that isolated agents converge as far as communicating ones, as ours did. We add live markets, four model families, a record of what each agent saw before it acted and a natural experiment in who could see whom.
blocks.zh: 在金融代理商中,SockAgent、TradingAgents和ContestTrade将捐款输入模拟市场或中央分配[4、16、17],FinCon的经理(分析师)将投资信仰传播给需要投资的代理商[31]。 我们的管理人员对自己的账户拥有权力,不需要任何捐助成为任何人的投入。 在模拟市场中,语言模型代理商表现出像人类那样依赖环境的偏见,并复制传统代理商模型错过的依赖路径的价格异常[27]。 与我们最接近的设计是史和霍利菲尔德,他比较了五个结构,孤立,领头板,与和没有领头板的合作对话,以及竞争性的对话,五个GPT-4o-mini代理生成α表达式,在2024年1月至2025年9月的450个市场数据模拟[25]. 他们发现,最好的结构取决于交易的股票,而孤立的代理人会像我们一样聚集在交流方面。 我们增加活市场,四个模范家庭, 记录每个代理在行动前所看到的, 以及一个自然的实验,谁能看到谁。

blocks.en: LiveTradeBench and Agent Market Arena share our motivation for forward evaluation against live markets, and Agent Market Arena finds that an agent’s design shapes its behaviour more than its underlying model does [ 5 , 32 ] . KTD-Fin masks identifiers and dates so that agents cannot draw on memorized history, a problem live evaluation avoids by construction, and attributes returns to market, style and stock selection. Passive market and style exposure explain most of its agents’ returns [ 33 ] . We likewise report active returns against an exposure-matched benchmark (Appendix A.3 ). FinMem shows why retained information belongs in the description of a decision architecture [ 18 ] , and CoALA and G-Memory provide vocabulary and structures for memory in single and multi-agent systems [ 19 , 20 ] . In our setting a manager’s conversation history, its own files, its peers’ published notes and the shared board are distinct records with different permissions and rules of exposure.
blocks.zh: LiveTrade Bench 和 Agent Market Arena 分享了我们针对现场市场进行前瞻性评估的动机, Agent Market Arena 发现,一个代理商的设计塑造了它的行为,而不是它的基本模型[5,32]. KTD- Fin 面具标识符和日期, 使代理无法引用已记住的历史, 问题现场评价通过构建而避免, 并将返回归属于市场、 风格和股票选择 。 被动的市场和风格曝光解释了其大部分代理商的收益[33]. 同样,我们对照一个与接触相称的基准(附录A.3)报告积极回报。 FinMem显示为什么保留的信息属于一个决策架构的描述[18],CoALA和G-Memory为单个和多代理系统中的内存提供了词汇和结构[19,20]. 在设定经理谈话历史时,

blocks.en: 8 Discussion
blocks.zh: 8 讨论情况

blocks.en: 8.1 Implications for swarm design
blocks.zh: 8.1 对群落设计的影响

blocks.en: DeepSeek’s and Grok’s communicating groups held more of the same stocks than their isolated groups, while Opus converged on TSM even without peers. Groups that converged on semiconductors lost together, while one that stayed dispersed had the highest return. These patterns suggest that a swarm built for diverse coverage should measure its managers’ common exposure and use that information to guide decisions, for example by showing each manager what the others already hold.
blocks.zh: DeepSeek和Grok的通讯团体持有的股票比其孤立的团体多,而Opus即使没有同伴,也聚集在TMM上. 聚集在半导体上的团体会一起消失,而留在分散的团体回报率最高。 这些模式表明,为多种覆盖范围而建立的群体应衡量其管理人员的共同接触情况,并利用这种信息指导决策,例如向每个管理人员说明其他人已经持有什么。

blocks.en: The different timescales of wording reuse and trading suggest that swarms need separate measures of communication and behaviour. A fresh post changed its readers’ wording within the morning, while the case studies traced the adoption of positions and decision rules over subsequent days. Shared wording therefore offers limited evidence about how agents will trade. The isolated groups’ synchronized trades and common decision thresholds also show why these behaviours need to be assessed against a no-peer baseline. Relative to that baseline, the clearest difference was in selling, making correlated exits a particular concern for collective portfolio risk.
blocks.zh: 措词重复使用和交易的不同时间尺度表明,群集需要单独的沟通和行为措施。 新的文章在上午改变了读者的措辞,而案例研究则追溯了其后几天采取的立场和决定规则。 因此,共用的措辞对代理人如何交易提供了有限的证据。 孤立集团的同步贸易和共同决定阈值也表明,为什么需要对照一个无比基线来评估这些行为。 与这一基线相比,最明显的区别在于出售,使相互关联的退出成为对集体投资组合风险的特别关切。

blocks.en: Some claims lost their original qualifications when managers summarized or relayed them, suggesting that shared records should retain the source and time window associated with each claim. They should also distinguish a peer’s action from the evidence offered for it. Research remained largely overlapping, and managers rarely used targeted requests to coordinate it. Explicit task allocation could be tested as a way to establish a division of work.
blocks.zh: 有些索赔在管理人员汇总或转发时丧失了原有资格,表明共用记录应保留与每项索赔有关的来源和时间窗口。 他们还应该区分同伴的行为和向其提供的证据。 研究在很大程度上仍然重叠,管理人员很少利用有针对性的请求来协调。 明确的任务分配可作为确定分工的一种方式加以检验。

blocks.en: The families also differed in how they used the same tools. Opus addressed posts to peers, disclosed positions and asked for verification, while Sol wrote long posts in compressed shorthand and Grok almost never named a peer. Sol accounted for 56% of the USD 7,259 of recorded inference cost while holding mostly SPY (Appendix F ). These differences raise the question of which regimes suit each family, although the present design cannot establish those comparisons.
blocks.zh: 家庭在如何使用相同工具方面也有所不同。 Opus向同行发送帖子,披露位置并要求核查,而Sol则用压缩的简写长帖子,Grok几乎从未给同行命名. 索尔占7,259美元记录的推论费用的56%,而大部分持有SPY(附录F)。 这些差异提出了每个家庭适用何种制度的问题,尽管目前的设计无法确定这些比较。

blocks.en: 8.2 Limitations
blocks.zh: 8.2 限制

blocks.en: Each combination of model and regime had one group, so the study describes groups rather than ranking regimes (Section 2.3 ). Each regime bundles its framing, its channel and its score display (Section 3 ). Family labels describe only the manager layer, because research models were shared across families. Scores were absent or zero for the first two trading days, and every view called peer content untrusted and the score experimental, which may weaken both cooperation and the incentive. The queue comparison covers morning cycles only, assumes that the timing effect in isolated groups would hold in communicating groups without a channel, and identifies the effect of a single morning’s posts rather than influence accumulated across days. A stronger study would replicate groups within each combination and use neutral framing to distinguish the effects of channel access from those of the instructions. It would also separate the score display from the channel, vary the untrusted-content framing, deliver scores from the first day and randomize the order in which managers act so that exposure is assigned by design.
blocks.zh: 模式和制度的每一个组合都有一组,因此,研究报告描述了各组,而不是排名制度(第2.3节)。 每个制度都将框架、信道和分数显示捆绑在一起(第3节)。 家族标签只描述经理层,因为研究模型在家族间共享. 前两个交易日中分数缺席或为零,每个视图都称同行内容不可信,分数实验,这可能会削弱合作和激励. 排队比较只涵盖上午周期,假定孤立群体的时间效应将维持在没有信道的交流群体中,并查明单个上午职位的影响而不是日复一日累积的影响。 一项更强有力的研究将复制每种组合中的组别,并使用中性框架来区分信道接入与指令的效应。 它还会将分数显示与频道分开,改变不可信内容框架,从第一天算起分数,并随机排列管理人员的行为顺序,以便根据设计分配曝光。

blocks.en: Seven trading days in one market environment support detailed accounts of disclosure, correction and convention formation, but not claims about durable investment performance. Operational disruptions also varied over the study period: a failure on 1 October removed 91 cycles from communicating groups only, queueing delayed Sol most, and the final day lost much of its research to provider errors (Appendix F ). The case studies show how influence travelled; they are not a count of how often each model behaved that way. The post census measures surface features of text, research requests are classified by the stocks they name, and recorded reasoning is not a complete account of a decision’s causes [ 21 ] . Presenting information to a model is not the same as its use [ 24 ] . The study used paper accounts, and inference costs were not deducted from returns. Some patterns, including the competitive board’s lack of disclosure and the lowest-ranked managers’ purchases, were noticed after the fact, and the analysis framework was developed after inspecting interim results, so the study is exploratory. A confirmatory study would specify in advance how return, risk, quality of evidence and cost are to be weighed.
blocks.zh: 在一个市场环境中的7个交易日支持披露、更正和公约形成的详细叙述,但不支持关于持久投资业绩的索赔。 在研究期间,业务中断也各不相同:10月1日的一次失败只取消了91个交流组的循环,排队时间最晚推迟了Sol,最后一天由于提供者错误而失去了大部分研究(Appendix F.). 案例研究表明,影响力是如何流动的;它们并不是每个模型行为频率的计算。 普查后测量文字的表面特征,研究请求按它们命名的种群分类,记录的推理并不是一个决定原因的完整叙述[21]. 向一个模型提供信息与其用途不同[24]. 研究使用了纸面账目,推论费用没有从回报中扣除. 一些模式,包括竞争董事会缺乏披露和级别最低的经理采购,在事后被注意到,分析框架是在检查临时结果之后制定的,因此研究是探索性的。 一项确认性研究将预先说明如何权衡回报、风险、证据质量和成本。

blocks.en: 9 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 9 结论

blocks.en: Across 200 language-model trading agents, peer exposure affected wording within a morning, while case studies traced the adoption of decision rules and positions over subsequent days. Shared holdings accounted for much of each group’s return, and communicating groups sold in step more often than isolated ones. Recorded exposure and comparisons with isolated groups help distinguish peer influence from common inputs, including the similarities that arose without communication.
blocks.zh: 在整个200个语言模式贸易代理商中,同行接触在一上午之内影响了措辞,而案例研究则追溯到决定规则和立场的通过。 股份占每个集团收益的大部分,通信集团比孤立集团更经常一步步地出售。 有记录的接触和与孤立群体的比较有助于区分同行影响和共同投入,包括没有沟通所产生的相似之处。

blocks.en: Communication also affected the evidence available to managers: some claims lost their qualifications as they were relayed, and in the clearest case a correction reached the original author without changing its notes. Research remained overlapping, and managers rarely used targeted requests to coordinate it. As shared notes accumulate over longer periods, a question for future work is how to preserve each claim’s evidence and the discussion around it within the swarm’s memory.
blocks.zh: 来文还影响到管理人员掌握的证据:有些索赔在转发后丧失了资格,在最清楚的案例中,更正到达了原提交人,而没有改变其笔记。 研究仍然重叠,管理人员很少利用有针对性的请求来协调。 随着共同说明在较长时期内的积累,未来工作的一个问题是如何保存每项索赔的证据,以及如何在群体记忆中围绕这些证据进行讨论。

blocks.en: Data and methodological transparency
blocks.zh: 数据和方法透明度

blocks.en: The study’s archive holds the source records up to the cutoff, coverage counts, financial reconciliations, case reports linked to their sources, and the scripts that produce the exposure-matched returns, attribution, permutation tests, post census, trading in step, queue comparison, rank and research analyses and the figures, together with the first-pass reviews’ condensed traces and quotation checks. A recomputation from the raw valuations by a reviewer who had not seen the analysis scripts reproduced every account’s returns and the attribution to within rounding, and the permutation tests within Monte Carlo error. A second blind recomputation, written from the definitions in Appendix A alone, reproduced the in-step, queue, rank and research estimates, with bootstrap intervals agreeing within resampling error. Appendix H maps the behavioural claims to the review findings behind them. Informational inputs are described by analytical function without disclosing proprietary supplier identities. The records are not publicly available.
blocks.zh: 研究的档案保存着源头记录直至截断、覆盖、财务核对、与源头相连的个案报告,以及产生曝光匹配的回报、归属、穿透测试、普查、分步交易、排队比较、排名和研究分析以及数字的脚本,以及头等评论的压缩痕迹和报价检查。 一名未看过分析脚本的审阅员对原始估价的重新计算,转载了每个帐户的回报和归结到四舍五入的归属,以及蒙特卡洛误差内的演化测试。 仅根据附录A中的定义编写的第二次盲目重算,转载了一步步的、排队的、等级的和研究的估计数,靴子间隔在重印错误中一致。 附 录 H将行为主张映射到背后的审查结论. 信息投入按分析功能进行描述,但不披露专有供应商身份。 这些记录不公开。

blocks.en: Each combination of model and regime contains one group, so a difference between two group means confounds the regime with that group’s history. As a reference we shuffle regime labels among the 50 accounts of each family (20,000 permutations) and ask how often the shuffled spread of regime means, or the model-by-regime interaction, is as large as observed. Interacting members of a group are not independent replications of its regime [ 22 ] , so treating accounts as exchangeable understates the variance of a group mean. A difference that does not exceed this reference is indistinguishable from account-level noise, and one that does may still reflect a single group’s shared history. Separate boards remove one pathway of interaction between groups, but common market movements and shared operating conditions still couple them [ 23 ] . The same shuffling, applied to managers’ research requests per trading day, gives the reference quoted in Section 6.3 .

blocks.en: For the 1,568 published board posts we compute simple text measures in every board group: whether a post names a peer pseudonym other than its author’s, first-person statements about the author’s own positions, requests that peers verify the content, disclaimers that the post is not an instruction or copy, claims to have verified something independently, and the share of whitespace-delimited tokens longer than 20 characters, which captures compressed, run-together prose. The patterns, in Appendix K , were refined after reading samples from each model, because one word (“independent”) served three different purposes across models. For a convention such as a recurring header, we record each member’s first use and test whether a peer’s earlier use appeared in the view delivered for the cycle that produced it. Wording reuse in Figure 6 counts a post, or a version of a member’s notes, once for each earlier author whose phrases of eight or more consecutive words it reused for the first time, provided that a view delivered to the reuser before publication contained the phrase and that the phrase occurs in no other group. blocks.en: A.7 Trading in step, decisions, ranks and research
blocks.zh: A.7 逐步贸易、决定、排名和研究

blocks.en: A fill outside SPY is in step if a groupmate filled an order in the same stock and direction within 30 minutes of it. A second measure takes the pairs of members who traded the same stock in the same direction on the same day and asks whether their first such fills fell within 30 minutes, which holds fixed which stocks were shared. A sale is a stop exit if it filled an attached stop-loss leg or a standalone stop order. Decisions are the orders managers submitted, read from their tool calls: limit and market orders and position closes outside SPY that the broker accepted or whose outcome it did not confirm. Protective stop orders are excluded, because they arm an exit in advance rather than act on the cycle’s information. For ranks, we read each manager’s own rank from the scorecard in its morning view and record whether that cycle bought a stock other than SPY. Research requests are the managers’ delegations to research sub-agents. A request concerns a stock if its objective names a traded ticker or one of 27 company names mapped to tickers, which 52 to 67% of requests do, depending on the family.

blocks.en: Each morning the platform queued all 50 managers of a family for 12:50 UTC, 40 minutes before the US market opened, and started them, at most nine at a time, in the order in which their work items had been created. blocks.en: Near pairs are members whose morning cycles started less than a minute apart. blocks.en: Two simpler comparisons are biased. Classifying pairs by whether the earlier cycle had ended ties exposure to that cycle’s length, and long cycles were the ones that traded, so that classification shows an apparent effect of about − 4 -4 points in isolated and communicating groups alike. Pooling pairs across mornings mixes mornings that differ in how many pairs of each kind they contain and in how much their members posted or traded. Pooled, the far pairs’ wording reuse is 12%, below the near pairs’ 14%, although within mornings it is higher. Every comparison is therefore made within a group-morning. Other thresholds for near and far pairs give same-morning effects on trades between − 1.4 -1.4 and 4.3 points, and the family-level estimates are too noisy to compare.

blocks.en: The scorecard reached managers far less consistently than the design intended. All 160 scorecards delivered on 1 October showed zero returns, all 349 views admitted on 2 October withheld scores, and nonzero scores first reached the groups on 4 or 5 October. Cards delivered on 9 October carried the 8 October close. Overall, 1,694 of the 2,198 views contained a scorecard and 504 withheld it. The score display that distinguishes competitive from collaborative boards was therefore active only for the last five of the seven trading days, after the groups had formed their first positions. Of 1,400 scheduled wakes, 1,377 completed. A further 1,767 self-scheduled wakes produced 1,350 completed cycles. Wakes requested by pings added 14 (Appendix E ), for 2,741 completed cycles in all.
