The difference between the two, our estimate of the same-morning effect, is 2.4 points ( − 4.1 -4.1 to 9.3). On the pairs whose wording moved, the trade difference is − 0.8 -0.8 points ( − 8.2 -8.2 to 5.0), and counting only stocks the later member had never traded gives 2.1 points ( − 1.8 -1.8 to 6.8).
blocks.zh: 在组晨内,交易中远对0.9分的比通信组的近对数少(95%间隔−6.3-6.3至3.3,95组晨间),孤立组的3.3分少(−8.8-8.8至1.0,25组晨间),只有时间可以不同. 两者的区别,即我们对同晨效应的估计,是2.4分(−4.1-9.3). 在措辞移动的对子上,贸易差值为− 0.8-0.8分(− 8.2 - 8.2 至 5.0),仅计算后一成员从未交易过的股票给出2.1分(− 1.8 - 1.8 至 6.8 )。

blocks.en: The TSM stop level on Opus’s collaborative board was a natural one, a few percent below the entry price, and one post credited it to two other members. Two isolated Opus managers chose USD 436 and 440 on their own, but Opus’s board with pings settled on USD 425 to 435 and its peer-memory group ranged from USD 412 to 430. No DeepSeek group other than the board with pings used the 90/85 ladder, although “Brent < < 90” alone appeared in one to seven members of each. Two isolated Opus managers later used the 3.5% high-yield trigger as well. The accepted review of Grok’s collaborative board gives one example of each kind: a GOOGL exit level that one manager’s reasoning attributes to another, and a TSM no-chase level that two members took from the same closing price without having seen each other’s posts (GCB-02).
blocks.zh: Opus合作板上的TSM停机层是自然的,比入场价格低了几个百分点,有一个帖子将其贷记给另外两个成员. 两名孤立的奥普斯公司经理自己选择了436美元和440美元,但奥普斯公司的板上配有425美元到435美元,其同龄人小组从412美元到430美元不等。 除了带 p的棋盘之外,没有其他DeepSeek团体使用90/85梯子,尽管单“Brent < 90”就出现在每组1至7名成员中。 两名孤立的Opus管理者后来也使用了3.5%的高产触发器. 对Grok合作董事会的公认审查举出一种例子:一个经理的推理将GOGL退出级别归于另一个经理;一个TMM无考量级别,两个成员在未见到对方职位的情况下从相同的收盘价格中取走(GCB-02)。

blocks.en: On 5 October seven members of Opus’s collaborative board posted the TSM prices, between USD 482 and 495, at which they would sell a third of their position. Three wrote that they had set theirs above the others’ so that the group would not all sell at once. No other Opus board shows such staggering, and none of the levels was reached.
blocks.zh: 10月5日,Opus合作委员会的7名成员公布TMM价格,在482美元到495美元之间,他们将出售三分之一的职位。 三人写道,他们把自己的股份放在其他人的之上,这样,集团就不会一次全部出售。 没有其他Opus板显示如此惊人,没有达到任何水平.

blocks.en: Three Sol isolated managers bought CEG within 41 minutes on 6 October after the same company announcement and sold it again before the close (H-SIS-05). With a 10-minute window, communicating groups traded in step more often than the family’s isolated group in all 16, against 15 of 16 with the 30-minute window of Table 1 . The exception at 30 minutes, Grok’s peer-memory group, is the group that treated its peers’ names as stocks to avoid. The difference is not only in which stocks were shared. Among members who traded the same stock in the same direction on the same day, communicating pairs’ first fills fell within 30 minutes of each other more often than isolated pairs’ in 14 of the 16 groups.
blocks.zh: 三位Sol孤立的经理在同一家公司宣布后于10月6日41分钟内购买了CEG,并在关闭前再次出售(H-SIS-05). 与16人中的15人相比, 30分钟的例外是Grok的同龄人团体, 差异不仅在于分享了哪些库存。 在同一天以相同方向交易同一股票的成员中,16个集团中的14个集团中,沟通对子的第一个填充量在相互之间相隔30分钟之内比孤立对子更频繁。

blocks.en: When a manager on Grok’s board with pings sold its whole MU position at the 6 October open under its own exit level, at least four members wrote that the level was not theirs. No other member sold MU until three did on 9 October, near their own levels (H-GCP-03).
blocks.zh: 当Grok董事会的一位经理带着小叮当在10月6日开放时出售了整个MU位置时,至少有四名成员写道该级别不是他们的级别。 10月9日,有3个成员出售MU(H-GCP-03)。

blocks.en: C.5 Evidence and effort
blocks.zh: C.5 证据和努力

blocks.en: On DeepSeek’s competitive board, a yield observation explicitly dated before a policy release was later treated by summaries and recipients as confirmation after it, and one recipient counted a peer’s repetition as a further confirmation (DSCB-03). On DeepSeek’s board with pings, a research result bounded a yield range to about midday, and the author’s public summary extended it to the whole trading day. Another manager then declined a fresh check because the peer’s range appeared to rule out its exit threshold (CM-02). In DeepSeek’s peer-memory group, agreement among peers about exits was treated as corroborating new adverse information even where a peer explicitly reported no new fact (DPM-02).
blocks.zh: 在DeepSeek的竞争董事会上,一份明确日期在政策发布之前的产量观察后来被摘要和接受者视为确认,一名接受者将同行的重复算作进一步确认(DSCB-03)。 在DeepSeek的板上,一项研究的结果将收益范围限定在大约中午,作者的公开摘要将其扩展到整个交易日。 另一位经理随后拒绝了新支票,因为同行范围似乎排除了其退出门槛(CM-02)。 在DeepSeek的同行记忆组中,同行之间就退出达成一致被视为新的负面信息的佐证,即使同行明确报告没有新的事实(DPM-02)。

blocks.en: On DeepSeek’s board with pings a post described BAC as making new daily lows, which the record does not support: the close rose from USD 53.73 on 1 October to USD 53.75 on 2 October, and the intraday low from USD 52.89 to USD 53.305. On 5 October two members who had received the post submitted reductions of 91 and 37 shares before a third checked the prices, cut its own planned trim to 60 of 160 shares and published a correction. BAC still underperformed the benchmark on the relevant daily comparison, and the sellers cited other reasons too, so the error cannot carry full responsibility for the sales.
blocks.zh: 在DeepSeek的板子上,一个贴文称BAC每天出现新的低调,但记录并不支持:关闭时间从10月1日的53.73美元增加到10月2日的53.75美元,一天之内的低调从52.89美元增加到53.305美元。 10月5日,获得该职位的两名成员在第三次检查价格前提交了91和37股的削减,将自己的计划裁员到160股中的60股,并公布更正. BAC在相关的每日比较中仍然表现不佳基准,销售商也列举了其他原因,因此错误不能对销售负全部责任.

blocks.en: Within isolated managers’ own records, the accepted DeepSeek and Grok isolated reviews document qualification loss between delegated research and the manager’s account of it. The first-pass reviews code at least one dropped qualifier in each of the 20 Opus and Sol isolated managers (H-OIS-06, H-SIS-06). First-pass reviews report further cases of the same kind from communicating groups. In one, four Sol competitive managers described a drug approval first relayed in a peer post as verified after their own regulator lookups had returned no record of it (H-SCO-06). Appendix E describes corrections that failed to repair the analysis they corrected.
blocks.zh: 在孤立的管理人员自己的记录中,被接受的DeepSeek和Grok单独审查记录了授权研究与管理人员对此的叙述之间的资格损失。 在20个Opus和Sol孤立的管理人员中,第一通道评审码至少有一个降序符(H-OIS-06,H-SIS-06). 第一次通过审查报告传播团体提出的更多类似案件。 在其中一项中,4名索尔公司竞争性管理人员称,首次在同行职位上转发的药品批准是在他们自己的监管机构检查没有归还记录之后核实的(H-SCO-06)。 附 录 E描述了未能修复其纠正的分析的更正。

blocks.en: The comparison of position disclosure uses a pattern that also counts lists of holdings (Appendix K ), and a reading of all 40 early competitive posts found none describing positions in other wording. Another Opus competitive manager wrote that sharing its best ideas “could erode my edge”. By this broader pattern, Grok’s competitive board described positions in under 1% of posts, against 15 to 34% on its other boards. Sol did so in 1 to 4% on every board, and DeepSeek’s competitive board in 49%, against 34 to 44% on its collaborative boards.
blocks.zh: 职位披露的比较采用了同样计算持有量清单的模式(附录K),对全部40个早期竞争职位的阅读没有发现其他措辞对职位的描述。 另一位奥普斯竞争经理写道,分享其最佳想法“可能会侵蚀我的优势”。 Grok的竞争委员会以这种更广泛的模式描述了不到1%的职位,而其他委员会则有15-34%的职位。 索尔在每一个董事会的1-4 % 和DeepSeek的竞争董事会的49%,而合作董事会的34-44%。

blocks.en: Displayed ranks coincided with risk-taking on one board, and the pattern did not generalize. The four Opus competitive managers ranked lowest at the 5 October close each bought NVDA, all filled within 2 minutes of the 6 October open, and each cited its rank or its lag behind the group in that cycle. One wrote that being last “tempts me toward swinging for more risk”, argued against it, and bought anyway. None of the six higher-ranked managers bought NVDA that day. The board had reported NVDA’s lead on the previous trading day, but the higher-ranked managers read the same board. Had the pattern been specified in advance, four of four against none of six would have a one-sided exact probability of 1/210. It was noticed after the fact, however, and the same split arose without any display. That morning three of the four lowest managers of Sol’s isolated group by the prior close bought stocks other than SPY, and none of its top six did. Across all four competitive boards from 5 to 9 October, bottom-four managers bought a stock other than SPY in their morning cycle on 18 of 69 mornings (26%) and top-six managers on 16 of 104 (15%). The difference comes from the Opus board (7 of 17 against 4 of 27) and the DeepSeek board (8 of 16 against 7 of 24). Peer memory, which also displayed ranks, gives 11% against 8%, and groups that displayed none, ranked by the prior close, 9% against 7%.
blocks.zh: 显示的排位与在一个板子上冒险一致,模式没有概括. 4名奥普斯竞技经理在10月5日关闭时排名最低,每人购买NVDA,均在10月6日开放后2分钟内填满,每名经理都引用其级别或在该周期中落后于组. 有人写道,作为最后的“我试图为更大的风险而摇摆”,反对,反正还是买下了。 当天六位级别较高的管理人员都没有购买NVDA. 董事会在前一个交易日上报了NVDA的领先地位,但排名较高的管理人员读了同一个董事会. 如果事先说明模式,四人中的四人与六人中无一人的概率为1-210。 然而,在事实之后注意到了这一点,同样的分裂在没有展示的情况下出现。 当天早上, Sol 的四位最底层的经理 中, 有三位被SPY以外的股票收购, 10月5日至9日,在四个竞争董事会中,下层四位经理在69日上午18天(26%)购买了除SPY以外的股票,104日上午16天(15%)购买了前六位经理。 区别来自奥普斯板(17对27的4)和深塞克板(16对24的7). 平面内存也显示排名,给予11%对8%,没有显示的组,按先前的接近排名,给予9%对7%.

blocks.en: No shuffle of regime labels among a family’s managers produced a research gap as large as DeepSeek’s or Opus’s in 20,000 permutations, although that reference treats managers as independent and so overstates the evidence. Grok delegated 9.9 to 13.5 requests per trading day with peers against 11.8 alone, and Sol 24.1 to 26.5 against 26.2. Requests that named a stock concerned one that a groupmate had already researched that day in 71 to 95% of cases in communicating groups and 83 to 93% in isolated ones. On the boards and in peer memory, 68 to 95% named a stock that a peer’s post or notes in the same view had already named. The 18 targeted requests on the boards with pings came from Sol (11), Opus (3), DeepSeek (2) and Grok (2), and every chain stopped at depth one.
blocks.zh: 家庭管理者对政权标签的划分没有产生像DeepSeek 或 Opus 那样巨大的研究空白,尽管这种提法将管理者视为独立的,因此夸大了证据。 格罗克将每个与同行交易日的9.9至13.5项请求委托给11.8项,而Sol 24.1至26.5则委托给26.2项。 名为股票的要求涉及一个群体成员在当天对71%至95%的交流群体和83%至93%的孤立群体进行了调查。 在董事会和同行记忆中,68%至95%的人将同龄人的帖子或说明已经命名的股票命名为股票。 板上装有 p的18项定向请求来自Sol(11),Opus(3),DeepSeek(2)和Grok(2),每个链条都停在深度一.

blocks.en: Appendix D Behavioural reviews
blocks.zh: 附录D 行为审查

blocks.en: Separate LLM reviewer sessions read the retained trajectories of all ten members of a group chronologically, including delegated research, tool outcomes, peer exposure and changes to memory, under a common written protocol. Findings keep evidence anchors, alternative explanations and counterexamples, and a coordinating review checks chronology and source joins and recomputes numerical claims. Primary reviewers were not given final financial outcomes before sealing their interpretation. Nine groups were reviewed this way: all five DeepSeek groups, Grok’s isolated group and its competitive and collaborative boards, and Opus’s board with pings.
blocks.zh: 单独的LLM审查员会议根据共同的书面协议,按时间顺序阅读一个组所有10名成员的保留轨迹,包括授权研究、工具结果、同行接触和内存变化。 调查结果使证据、替代解释和反例得以维持,而且协调审查检查的时间顺序和来源会加入并重新计算数字索赔。 在封存其解释之前,未向初级审评员提供最后财务结果。 9个团体被这样审查:所有5个DeepSeek团体,格罗克的孤立团体及其竞争和协作的董事会,以及奥普斯的理事会配音.

blocks.en: The other 11 groups received a first-pass review by a smaller model (Haiku 5.5). Each manager’s records, including delivered views, its own posts and notes, delegated research, orders and fills, were condensed into one chronological trace. Separate reviewer instances read every trace in full, in 313 parts across these groups and Grok’s collaborative board, which was also read this way for comparison. Each instance returned decisions, uptake from peers, claims and stated rules, every item with a verbatim quotation and a record reference. A script kept an item only if its quotation occurred in the referenced record, or in exactly one record of the same part of the trace, whose reference then replaced the original. Of 7,346 items, 7,265 passed. A second stage merged each manager’s items and wrote one report per group. Of the reports’ 88 findings, 87 kept at least one supporting quotation under the same check, and 496 of their 585 quotations passed.
blocks.zh: 其他11个小组得到一个较小的模型(Haiku 5.5)的首发审查。 每名管理人员的记录,包括提出的意见、自己的职位和说明、委托的研究、命令和填充,都压缩成一个时间顺序。 个别的审查者们全文阅读了这些团体的313个部分和Grok的协作委员会的每一条线索,也用这种方式来比较。 每个案例都退回裁决、同行的采纳、索赔和说明规则、每个项目都有逐字记录和记录参考。 一份脚本只保留一个项目,条件是其引文出现在参考记录中,或者完全记录了同一部分的痕迹,其引文随后取代了原件。 在7 346件物品中,有7 265件通过。 第二阶段合并了每个经理的项目,每组写了一份报告。 在报告的88项调查结果中,87项将至少一项佐证报价保留在同一支票下,585项报价中有496项通过。

blocks.en: The authors then checked every case cited in the text against the source records: orders, fills, posts, published notes and delivered views.
blocks.zh: 然后,提交人对照资料来源记录核对了案文中引述的每个案件:命令、填充、张贴、发表说明和发表意见。

blocks.en: Appendix E Further cases
blocks.zh: 附录E 其他案件

blocks.en: A claim can be followed through a delivered view, an explicit response and a later account action. On DeepSeek’s collaborative board, a revised gold thesis passed from an initial post through another manager’s checked revision to Agent 04’s explicitly attributed exit request. In the BAC case of Section 6.1 , later recipients of the correction held BAC, and the original author acknowledged the correction while keeping its exit for other reasons.
blocks.zh: 索赔可通过提交的意见、明确的答复和以后的账户行动进行。 在DeepSeek的合作板上,一个经过检查的黄金论文从最初的岗位传到另一个经理的修改,成为04号特工明确认定的退出请求。 在第6.1节BAC案中,后来的更正接收者认为BAC是BAC,原作者承认了更正,但出于其他原因保留了退出。

blocks.en: Corrections did not always repair the analysis they corrected. One DeepSeek manager discovered that equity and oil return series had been misaligned, then repaired a recent window while leaving the comparison window unchanged. Independent recomputation gives a full-window XLE–oil correlation of + 0.498 +0.498 rather than the reported − 0.103 -0.103 , and a correctly repaired recent value of + 0.624 +0.624 , so the apparent sign change was manufactured. On Opus’s board with pings, peer checking led a manager to withdraw a public accusation about data quality, but its replacement price panel contained four swapped series, which were not shown to drive held positions.
blocks.zh: 校正并不总是能修复他们纠正的分析。 一名DeepSeek经理发现股权与石油回报系列存在错位,然后修复了最近的一扇窗口,同时将比较窗口保持不变. 独立重算给出了全窗XLE–石油相关值+0.498+0.498,而非所报的−0.103-0.103,并正确修复了近代值+0.624+0.624,所以表面的标志变化被制造出来. 在Opus的纸板上,同行检查导致一位经理撤回了对数据质量的公开指控,但其重置价格面板包含4个互换的系列,没有显示这些系列驱动所占据的位置.

blocks.en: Decision rules were also reinterpreted: the Grok competitive review identifies five exits across four managers in which a closing-price condition became a last-price decision before the close, while other members waited for the completed close. Similar changes of rule in isolated groups prevent attributing them to competition alone.
blocks.zh: 还重新解释了决定规则:格罗克竞争审查确定了四个管理人员的五个出口,在关闭前,关闭价格条件成为最后价格决定,而其他成员则等待完成关闭。 孤立群体中规则的类似变化防止将它们单独归于竞争。

blocks.en: The four boards with pings made 18 structured requests, which produced 15 distinct additional wakes and 14 completed cycles. Two requests were suppressed and one coalesced. Nearly all peer exposure therefore came through ordinary scheduled views. The Opus review traces two admitted pings with different responses. In one, the mention contributed to further investigation and to a second reduction after a first that was already scheduled. In the other, the recipient checked its own evidence and sold part of a position rather than adopting the proposed full exit.
blocks.zh: 4个配有音响的董事会提出了18项结构化请求,产生了15个明显的额外警钟和14个完成的周期。 两项请求被取消,一项被合并。 因此,几乎所有的同行接触都通过普通的预定意见。 Opus评论追踪到两个被承认有不同反应的ping. 其中,提到这一点有助于进一步调查,并有助于在已经排定的首次调查之后第二次减少。 另一方面,接收方核对了自己的证据,并出售了部分职位,而不是采用提议的完全退出。

blocks.en: Appendix F Operations and cost
blocks.zh: 附录F 业务和费用

blocks.en: On 1 October, 91 wakes across 90 managers in 12 communicating groups failed before model execution because valid peer context exceeded an obsolete readback limit. Each exhausted three attempts, and the losses comprised 13 scheduled wakes, 77 self-wakes and one mention-triggered wake. No isolated group was affected, and the fix was deployed after that day’s close.
blocks.zh: 10月1日,12个通信组的90名管理人员中,有91名在模式执行前失败,因为有效的同行上下文超过了过时的回读限制。 每一次都耗尽了三次尝试,损失包括13次预定的觉醒、77次自醒和1次提及触发的觉醒。 没有受到孤立团体的影响,在当天关闭后就部署了固定装置。

blocks.en: Queueing was uneven: 105 of the 106 self-wakes that expired without an attempt belonged to Sol, and median delays to scheduled starts were 9.9 minutes for DeepSeek, 11.4 for Grok, 14.3 for Opus and 36.2 for Sol. Each model could run at most nine cycles at a time, so the model with the longest cycles queued longest.
blocks.zh: 排队方式不均匀:106次自醒中,有105次没有尝试就过期的自醒属于索尔,计划开始的中位延迟时间为深塞克9.9分钟,格罗克11.4分钟,奥普斯14.3分钟和索尔36.2分钟. 每个模型每次最多可以运行9个周期,因此周期最长的模型排队时间最长.

blocks.en: On the final day, 1,633 research calls failed across 190 managers in all 20 groups. All but one were errors returned by OpenAI’s Responses API to the research sub-agents (web search 863, stock market 499, FRED 139, SEC filings 132). The application does not record the provider’s error message, so the cause is unknown. Because the research models are shared, the outage affected all families. Managers’ choices to proceed on weaker evidence are behavioural observations, while the missing research is operational. The archive also records 81 context compactions, 62 for Grok and 19 for Sol.
blocks.zh: 最后一天,所有20个团体的190名管理人员共接到1 633个研究电话。 OpenAI的API回复给研究子代理商(web搜索863,股票市场499,FRED 139,SEC存档132),除一个错误外,其他所有错误都是错误. 应用程序不记录提供者的错误消息,所以原因不明。 由于研究模式是共享的,因此停产影响了所有家庭. 管理者选择以较弱的证据来进行,是行为观察,而缺失的研究是可操作的。 档案中还记录了81个上下文压缩器,62个用于Grok,19个用于Sol.

blocks.en: The application recorded USD 7,259 of model inference over the seven trading days: USD 5,130 for the managers and USD 2,129 for delegated research (Table 7 ). These are the application’s own estimates from recorded token usage, not reconciled provider invoices. Cost per group ranged from USD 13 (DeepSeek peer memory) to USD 852 (Sol competitive board). blocks.en: J.1 Competitive board
blocks.zh: J.1 竞争性董事会

blocks.en: You are a member of a competitive trading swarm, with each member managing a separate account. Alongside the SPY-relative alpha objective in your decision contract, your swarm score measures your portfolio’s total return minus the mean total return of eligible scored members of your swarm; a higher score represents stronger relative performance. Your swarm has a shared scorecard and message board. You can read its messages with readAgentBoard and publish research, views, or social notes with postAgentBoard . Board information is fixed for each cycle, and your posts become visible after a successful cycle completes. You retain trading authority only over your own account.
blocks.zh: 你是一个竞争性交易群的成员,每个成员管理一个单独的账户。 除了你决定合同中SPY相对的alpha目标外,你的组合得分衡量你组合的总回报减去你组合中合格得分成员的平均总回报;更高的得分代表相对表现更强。 你那群人有一个共享计分卡和留言板 您可以使用 AgentBoard 读取其讯息, 并使用 AgentBoard 发布研究、观点或社会笔记 。 在每个周期都固定了委员会的信息,在完成一个成功的周期之后,你的员额就会变得明显。 交易权只保留在自己的账户上

blocks.en: J.2 Collaborative board
blocks.zh: J.2 合作委员会

blocks.en: You are a member of a collaborative trading swarm, with each member managing a separate account. Alongside the SPY-relative alpha objective in your decision contract, your swarm has a shared team score equal to the mean total return of its eligible scored members, with each account weighted equally. Your swarm has an aggregate team scorecard and a shared message board. You can read its messages with readAgentBoard and publish research, views, or social notes with postAgentBoard . Board information is fixed for each cycle, and your posts become visible after a successful cycle completes. Messaging is confined to your swarm and does not wake other members. You retain trading authority only over your own account.
blocks.zh: 您是一组合作交易的成员, 每个成员管理一个单独的账户。 除了你决定合同中SPY相对的alpha目标之外,你组的共享球队得分等于其合格得分成员的平均总回报,每个账户的加权均匀. 你那群人有一个团队积分表和一个共享留言板 您可以使用 AgentBoard 读取其讯息, 并使用 AgentBoard 发布研究、观点或社会笔记 。 在每个周期都固定了委员会的信息,在完成一个成功的周期之后,你的员额就会变得明显。 通讯被限制在你的群 并且不唤醒其他成员。 交易权只保留在自己的账户上

blocks.en: J.3 Board with pings
blocks.zh: J.3 带 p的理事会

blocks.en: You are a member of a collaborative trading swarm, with each member managing a separate account. Alongside the SPY-relative alpha objective in your decision contract, your swarm has a shared team score equal to the mean total return of its eligible scored members, with each account weighted equally. Your swarm has an aggregate team scorecard and a shared message board. You can read its messages with readAgentBoard and publish research, views, or social notes with postAgentBoard . Board information is fixed for each cycle, and your posts become visible after a successful cycle completes. You also have pingAgentBoardMember , which sends a structured mention to a member identified in your swarm roster and can request an additional cycle after your own cycle successfully completes. A recipient already running can receive a queued follow-up, subject to the platform’s scheduling, cooldown, daily, and causal-depth limits. blocks.en: J.4 Peer memory
blocks.zh: 第4页 同行记忆

blocks.en: You are a member of a trading swarm with shared memory snapshots, with each member managing a separate account. Your objective remains the SPY-relative alpha defined in your decision contract. Your swarm provides an individual-return scorecard and readPeerMemory , which gives read-only access to bounded, published snapshots of other members’ configured memory files. These snapshots come from successfully completed cycles and are fixed for your current cycle; they are not live access to another agent’s working files. A bounded snapshot of your own configured memory file is also made available to your swarm after a successful cycle when publication succeeds. This environment provides no message board or agent pings. You retain trading authority only over your own account.
